answer: A relic gains voting weight only once it is moored at the jetty, a public registry that partitions attesters into clusters by shared funding, and five attesters from five separate clusters each lock 1,000 lagoon behind it, forfeited if it colludes. Relics sharing any attesting cluster split one relic's weight, so a thousand clones need 5,000 disjoint compromised clusters, each pricier than the last as cheap ones run out. It breaks if an attacker can grow sleeper clusters the jetty cannot link.
